verdict.rationale: The evidence shows refunds via the API: the MCP server wraps a modification tool to 'refund a captured payment', credential docs mention a dedicated credential for unreferenced refunds, and modification requests return result and refusal codes. Dashboard refunding is only implied by the Customer Area being described as a place to 'manage your account and transactions', and nothing distinguishes full from partial refunds. Missing for 10: explicit partial-refund (amount-specified) support, explicit Customer Area/dashboard refund workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
